Command: Do not inflict a wound on a dedicated animal
Summary: The command: Do not inflict a wound on a dedicated animal (Leviticus 22:21). An animal dedicated to the LORD was not to be wounded or marred, since only the unblemished was acceptable.
Commandment: Do not inflict a wound on a dedicated animal.
Application: It cannot be practised as written without the standing temple and Aaronic priesthood; its enduring lesson is God's holiness, the cost of atonement, and worship offered exactly as God appoints.
Purpose: TRADITIONAL reading: only an unblemished gift was fitting for the LORD; marring a dedicated animal dishonoured the offering.
